tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground: the Dashboard and Usage scroll areas, the canvas.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Boxed instruments: Needs you rows, Right now band, chart cards, KPI hover.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised controls: secondary buttons, project tiles, list row hover.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Tracks and pressed fills: meter tracks, neutral badges, button hover.

tokens.name: field-bg
tokens.usage: Input and select backgrounds.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the Customise sheet.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside a region: KPI separators, chart grid, card edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Dividers between list rows and around popovers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Button borders and hovered rows.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and checkboxes: the one border that must reach 3:1.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, figures and headings on surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, captions and deltas on surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Counts, separators and axis labels on surface-0 and surface-1. Also the idle state mark.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (primary button).

tokens.name: text-on-success
tokens.usage: Glyph inside a done mark on success.

tokens.name: text-on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger fills.

tokens.name: text-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on the fixed brand gradient.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, sliding indicators (KPI bar, tab underline), the arrival ring. The default accent; the user can pick another in Appearance.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-active
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and marks on surface-0 to surface-2: links, the pressed KPI sparkline, today's bar.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row and chip fill. Source: accent at 16% (dark) / 10% (light).

tokens.name: accent-soft-border
tokens.usage: Border of an accent-soft surface. Source: accent at 36% / 28%.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Border of a pinned or focused tile. Source: accent at 55%.

tokens.name: accent-faint
tokens.usage: The faintest accent wash (the pinned project tile). Source: accent at 6%.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 px solid focus outline on every interactive element; 7.55:1 on dark surface-0, 6.94:1 on light.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done marks and the finished state. Always with a word or check glyph.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on surface-0 to surface-2 and on success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge fill. Source: success at 14% / 10%.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs you: the only amber on the Dashboard. Also a plan window at 80% or more.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Needs-you count and warning text on surface-0 to surface-2 and on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Needs you row fill. Source: warning at 14% / 10%.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Needs you row border. Source: warning at 55%.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed runs and a limited plan window. Always with a word or glyph; it differs from success in lightness in the light theme, but pair it with text in both.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error text on surface-0 to surface-2 and on danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error badge fill. Source: danger at 14% / 10%.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Working: the breathing mark's ring and the running state.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Running text on surface-0 to surface-2 and on info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info badge fill. Source: info at 14% / 10%.

tokens.name: state-working
tokens.usage: An agent or run that is working.

tokens.name: state-waiting
tokens.usage: A run waiting on a decision.

tokens.name: state-done
tokens.usage: A finished agent or run.

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: A failed agent or run.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: An idle or paused agent or run.

tokens.name: brand-from
tokens.usage: First stop of the mark's gradient. Fixed in both themes. The mark only.

tokens.name: brand-to
tokens.usage: Last stop of the mark's gradient. Fixed in both themes. The mark only.

tokens.name: brand-ui-from
tokens.usage: First stop of the UI gradient: meter fills, the pacing arc, the empty-state glyph. Never behind text, borders or focus rings.

tokens.name: brand-ui-to
tokens.usage: Last stop of the UI gradient.

tokens.name: aura-from
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: the violet corner of a hero card's aura (Briefing, Pacing). brand-ui-from at 18% / 12%. Behind the card only; text sits on surface-1 through it and keeps its contrast.

tokens.name: aura-to
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: the blue corner of a hero card's aura. brand-ui-to at 12% / 8%.

tokens.name: chart-s1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (largest). 11.96:1 on dark surface-1, 12.53:1 on light.

tokens.name: chart-s2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. 3.35:1 dark, 3.06:1 light. Fills alternate bright and mid so neighbours differ in lightness.

tokens.name: chart-s3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. 13.99:1 dark, 12.35:1 light.

tokens.name: chart-s4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. 3.55:1 dark, 3.42:1 light.

tokens.name: chart-s5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5. 11.79:1 dark, 10.33:1 light.

tokens.name: chart-s6
tokens.usage: Reserved sixth series. 3.49:1 dark, 4.32:1 light.

tokens.name: chart-other
tokens.usage: The folded Other series. 3.23:1 dark, 3.09:1 light.

tokens.name: chart-unknown
tokens.usage: Unpriced usage: hatched, hollow dots. Unknown is never drawn as zero.

tokens.name: chart-hatch
tokens.usage: Gap colour between stacked segments and in hatching.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis labels and ticks.

tokens.name: chart-focus
tokens.usage: Crosshair and the focused bar outline.

tokens.name: dash-strip-bar
tokens.usage: Bars of the 14-day activity strip.

tokens.name: dash-strip-today
tokens.usage: Today's bar in the activity strip.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Reporting lines between agent rows when the parent has no role colour.

tokens.name: role-1
tokens.usage: Role colour 1 (the root by default). Role colours tint marks and reporting lines; never text.

tokens.name: role-2
tokens.usage: Role colour 2.

tokens.name: role-3
tokens.usage: Role colour 3.

tokens.name: role-4
tokens.usage: Role colour 4.

tokens.name: role-5
tokens.usage: Role colour 5.

tokens.name: role-6
tokens.usage: Role colour 6.

tokens.name: role-7
tokens.usage: Role colour 7.

tokens.name: role-8
tokens.usage: Role colour 8.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Row second lines, quiet list headings, badges.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Intentional addition: the value on a stat card and inside the burn dial. Tabular-nums.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Intentional addition: the Briefing greeting. One per page.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Counts, costs in rows, times. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Intentional addition for the redesign: the one hero figure of a page (period spend on Usage). Tabular-nums; counts up on arrival.

tokens.name: space-0h
tokens.usage: Gap between a KPI label and its value.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge; bar gaps.

tokens.name: space-1h
tokens.usage: Chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows, inside rows, KPI tile block padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inline padding, KPI tile inline padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter and grid gap under 1100 px.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Badge height.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 1100 px; gap between page bands.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the Briefing and the work area.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Topbar height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a mini meter; the pacing gauge.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars' top corners, chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Hovered list rows, small buttons, the priced chip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Project tiles, Needs you rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, hero cards, stat cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, marks, meter tracks.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: A hovered project tile.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Popovers and the chart tooltip.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the Customise sheet.

duration.note: Every duration collapses to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion or Appearance > Reduce motion.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: The user's own press: button colour, active scale.

tokens.name: dur-fade
tokens.usage: Opacity-only fades.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Exits and hover fills.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Entries: rows rising, view swaps.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Sliding indicators, large entries, meter fills.

tokens.name: dur-draw
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: data drawing itself once on arrival (bars growing, arcs and sparklines drawing, figures counting up).

tokens.name: dur-pulse
tokens.usage: One breath of a working mark. The only looping motion.

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay step between staggered items; at most 6 steps.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entries and data drawing.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Sliding indicators, collapses, breathing.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Switch thumbs and popovers only. Never on layout or page-level motion.

tokens.name: motion-distance
tokens.usage: Rise of a large entry. 0 under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-distance-sm
tokens.usage: Rise of a row or view. 0 under reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-scale-from
tokens.usage: Start scale of a pop. 1 under reduced motion.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons in rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions in dialogs.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Glyphs inside badges and marks.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty-state and section icons.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Topbar height.
